Name: Babel Rising 3D (2013)
Description: Play a wrathful god stopping the Tower of Babel: hurl lightning, floods and earthquakes at the builders below.

Achievements.Name: Falling Stone
Achievements.Description: Crushed 20 workers with one giant boulder.

Achievements.Name: Great balls of fire
Achievements.Description: Destroyed a section of the tower with a meteor shower.

Achievements.Name: Holy wave
Achievements.Description: Use a tidal wave that spares cursed jar bearers.

Achievements.Name: Blown away
Achievements.Description: Send a worker flying 50 meters away in a sand storm.

Achievements.Name: Deity
Achievements.Description: Kill 50 workers in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Patient god
Achievements.Description: Use two distinct level 3 powers in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Eclectic god
Achievements.Description: Use each passive power and each scroll once.

Achievements.Name: Cursed!
Achievements.Description: Show no fear when destroying the cursed jars.

Achievements.Name: Survivor
Achievements.Description: Stop the construction of the tower when everything seems lost.
